product_overview: Noubtigo is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for managing customer flow across queues and appointments. It helps businesses handle tickets, customer tracking, and service operations within isolated company workspaces.
core_goals: Improve customer experience during physical visits
Allow customers to track queue position remotely
Support multiple businesses through subscription plans

features.name: Ticket Management
features.description: Users can create tickets for new or existing customers, view ticket lists, and update ticket status through queue operations.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the ticket management area -> Create a new ticket for an existing customer -> Review the ticket appears in the list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the ticket management area -> Create a new ticket for a new customer -> Review the ticket appears in the list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the ticket management area -> View the ticket list -> Update a ticket status -> See the status change reflected in the list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the ticket management area -> Select an active ticket -> Put the ticket on hold -> Resume the ticket service -> See the ticket return to the active flow
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the ticket management area -> Select a ticket -> Cancel the ticket with a reason -> See the ticket remain stored in the system
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the ticket management area -> Select a cancelled ticket -> Reopen the ticket -> See the ticket return to the waiting queue
